Attach Letter of Authorisation / Sponsor letter with the manufacturer authorising your company to represent them for registration
Manufacturing Site Location
helpText: Please ensure you provide the site address of the manufacturer and not the administrative address

title: Please select the corresponding mSupply item
Please select the corresponding mSupply item
Select where the product is already registered
helpText: If registered in more than one, select one of the Tongan recognised drugs regulatory authorities as priority (i.e. "Australia", "NZ", Malaysia etc )

title: Existing Product Selection
helpText: Once you have selected the correct product the product's details will be pre-filled into the application. Please note pre-filled data can't be edited

title: Corresponding Registration ID
helpText: This is auto populated for Australia, NZ and Fiji. If not registered in any country type "N/A"

title: Product Specification
helpText: A copy of the finished medicinal drug specification(s) from the company responsible for the batch release of the finished medicinal drug should be provided.

title: Description of Product
helpText: A full visual description of the medicinal drug including colour, size, shape, and other relevant features

title: Container Type and Type of Seal
Storage conditions
helpText: Include measurement unit of storage temperature (eg: degree Celsius)

title: Medicinal Products Classification
options: CLASS 1: Medicinal Drugs available from licensed retail outlets
CLASS 2A: Medicinal Drugs available from registered pharmacy premises under the supervision of a registered pharmacist, where advice of pharmacist at point of sale is not required
CLASS 2B : Medicinal Drugs available from registered pharmacy premises under the supervision of a registered pharmacist, where advice of pharmacist at point of sale is required
CLASS 3: Medicinal Drugs available on prescription only and dispensed by a pharmacist or Assistant Pharmacist
CLASS 4: Medicinal Drugs available on special prescription only and dispensed by a pharmacist or Assistant Pharmacist
CLASS 5: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances subject to Special Import Controls
CLASS 6: Medicinal Drugs available from Veterinary Practitioners for Animal Use

title: Declaration
helpText:
I confirm and declare that:

-  I, the undersigned hereby certify and declare that all the information in this application and accompanying documentation is correct, complete, and true to the best of my knowledge.

-  I, the undersigned hereby take full responsibility on the quality, safety, and efficacy, of the listed medicinal product over its lifetime and will ensure that each individual batch imported complies with laws in force in the Kingdom of Tonga. If required, I will cooperate with any official of the Tonga Ministry of Health in performing inspection.


- I, the undersigned hereby confirm and agree that listing of this application for Inclusion into the Register of Medicinal Drugs does not constitute to a marketing authorisation or registration of the medicinal product in Tonga.

-  I, the undersigned hereby confirm and agree to furnish the Tonga Ministry of Health with registration information as required in respect to an authorised medicinal product within such time as is stipulated in the communication.

-  I, the undersigned hereby acknowledge that if the required information requested by the Tonga Ministry of Health is without valid reasons submitted the medicinal product shall be delisted from the Register of Medicinal Drugs.

- I, the undersigned hereby confirm and agree that Tonga Ministry of Health shall have the authority to suspend or cancel the Medicinal Drug Registration if the medicinal product is found not to have not complied with laws in force in the Kingdom of Tonga.

- I also agree to follow the Tongan legal requirements related to listing of medicinal products.

- I also consent to the processing of information provided to the Tonga Ministry of Health.
